effects.l1: Stroke of luck: move the Yin OR Yang die by 1 (an artificial double gives no double effects).
effects.l2: Controller of energy: swap the Yin and Yang results.
effects.l3: Controller of flow: move BOTH dice by 1 each.
effects.l4: Master of energy: reroll one die and keep either result.

system.description: Bend the dice after rolling. Can't create a critical success or cancel a double zero. May be used after seeing the roll.
